phase: Phase C1 - barycentric light time and Shapiro delay: materiality survey (analysis only, no production change)
written: 2026-10-22, before any C1 number was computed
motivation: The Orekit/GMAT trial (agent-sandbox/orekit-gmat-oracle/REPORT.md s4.5) found that lunar_od solves light time Newtonian in the Moon-centred frame: vs the DSN/Moyer barycentric formulation 1.83-1.94 m in two-way range, -52..+63 um/s in counted Doppler, 9.5-9.9 km in one-way range; the Shapiro delay (~7.2 m) and the station-time conversion of the measured interval are absent. That was one station, one 2 h window. C1 decides, per term and per observable, whether the term is material for this project's OD, before any production change

reference_model.implementation: independent study code studies/phase17/scripts/phase_c1_light_time_survey.py; production modules are imported read-only for station state providers, spacecraft history interpolation and the production observable values the parity gates compare against
reference_model.MOON: Newtonian light time in the Moon-centred inertial frame (the production model), re-implemented in the survey code
reference_model.SSB: Newtonian light time in the solar-system barycentric frame: every endpoint = its Moon-centred position + the Moon's SSB position (SPICE, the kernels the production loader uses) at that endpoint's own epoch
reference_model.SHAPIRO: Moyer (2000) eq. 8-38 per leg, (1+gamma)=2: dt_B = 2 GM_B/c^3 ln[(r1B + r2B + r12)/(r1B + r2B - r12)] for B in {Sun, Earth, Moon, Jupiter barycentre}, GM from the loaded gm kernel, body position at the leg's receive epoch
reference_model.TIME_SCALE: the measured interval is kept by the station in TT (TAI-rate); c/2 x round_trip x d(TDB-TT)/dTDB at the receive epoch, d(TDB-TT)/dt from SPICE unitim by central difference
reference_model.epochs: survey epochs are the production epochs (seconds past et0, read as TDB)

observables.two_way_range: every KP2 range row (receive-tagged, zero transponder delay, half round trip)
observables.counted_doppler: every KP2 counted-Doppler row (Tc = 60 s, receive-tagged count interval, m/s equivalent y = c/(2Tc)(tau_end - tau_start))
observables.delta_dor: the R1O-D2 Goldstone-Canberra rows of CANON k0 (differential one-way, common transmit event)
observables.one_way_range: the downlink-only light time to the same KP2 range receive epochs (the RAZEL one-way convention); reported, not used for OD impact

population: the 10 KP2 cells (5 orbits x epochs k0, k12; CANON, O1, O2, O3, O5), SIMPLIFIED dynamics (the trajectory only sets the geometry; the terms are light-time physics)

gates.S1_parity_range: the survey's MOON two-way range reproduces the production KP2 range values: max |diff| <= 1e-6 m over all rows of all cells
gates.S2_parity_doppler: the survey's MOON counted Doppler reproduces the production KP2 Doppler values: max |diff| <= 1e-7 m/s
gates.S3_parity_ddor: the survey's MOON delta-DOR reproduces the production D2 rows: max |diff| <= 1e-12 s
gates.S4_convergence: every light-time solve in every frame reaches |equation residual| <= 1e-12 s
gates.S5_orekit_crosscheck: informational: FRAME and SHAPIRO_SUN+EARTH two-way range magnitudes compared with the Orekit/GMAT trial ranges (1.83-1.94 m; ~7.2 m)

noise_levels.PROJECT: range 5 m, Doppler 1e-4 m/s, delta-DOR 5 nrad (the KP2 / R1O-D2 values)
noise_levels.DSN_REALISTIC: range 1 m, Doppler 3e-5 m/s (0.03 mm/s at 60 s), delta-DOR 5 nrad

od_impact.method: linear bias mapping at the truth: delta_theta = (H^T W H + P0^-1)^-1 H^T W delta_y, reported as max |delta_theta_i / sigma_i| over the 6 state components and constant K, sigma from the square-root (QR) posterior
designs: RANGE_ONLY: KP2 range rows, 6-state + constant K
RANGE_DOPPLER_FREE_BIAS: KP2 range + counted Doppler with one free bias per Doppler pass (the KP2 FREE design), 6-state + constant K
od_impact.prior: KP2 PRIOR_SD on the state, no K prior

materiality_rule.observable_level: a term is OBSERVABLE_MATERIAL for an observable if its max |effect| over the population >= 0.1 sigma of that observable at DSN_REALISTIC noise
materiality_rule.od_level: a term is OD_MATERIAL if, for some design and noise level, max |delta_theta / sigma| >= 0.1 in some cell
materiality_rule.decision: IMPLEMENT if OD_MATERIAL or OBSERVABLE_MATERIAL; DOCUMENT_ONLY otherwise. A term that is OBSERVABLE_MATERIAL only for one_way_range is classified CONVENTION (no DSN one-way range observable is modelled)
materiality_rule.gate_veto: if S1, S2, S3 or S4 fails, the outcome for the affected observable is C1_INCONCLUSIVE

not_in_scope: ITRF realization, EOP, station tides, DE421 vs DE440 (C3, C4); media delays (C5); the angular observables (az/el) and stellar aberration; any production change
